scripts.build:web-ui: cd web-ui && bun install --frozen-lockfile && bun run build
scripts.build:teach-me-widgets: bun build src/teach-me/widgets/index.ts --outfile ../dist/teach-me/tm-widgets.js --target browser --format iife --minify && bun build src/teach-me/widgets/src/base.css --outfile ../dist/teach-me/tm-base.css --minify
scripts.build:all: bun run build && bun run build:web-ui && bun run build:platforms
scripts.build:release: bun run build:web-ui && bun run build:platforms && bun run build:teach-me-widgets && bun run generate:assets
scripts.test: bun run check:test-home-env && bun run scripts/test-with-isolated-home.ts
scripts.test:unit: bun run check:test-home-env && find src/__tests__ -name '*.test.ts' ! -path '*integration*' -print0 | xargs -0 bun run scripts/test-with-isolated-home.ts
scripts.test:integration: bun run check:test-home-env && find src/__tests__ -name '*.test.ts' -path '*integration*' -print0 | xargs -0 bun run scripts/test-with-isolated-home.ts
scripts.test:coverage: bun run check:test-home-env && bun run scripts/test-coverage.ts
scripts.test:watch: bun run check:test-home-env && bun run scripts/test-with-isolated-home.ts --watch
